item.title: Immunovant Arthritis Trial
item.description:
• Summary: Shares of Immunovant surged following positive data from an arthritis trial for its anti-FcRn antibody batoclimab. The treatment demonstrated significant efficacy in reducing disease activity, bolstering the company's pipeline in autoimmune indications.
  • MoAs: FcRn antagonist (neonatal Fc receptor inhibition reduces pathogenic IgG levels)
  • Sources: Stat News
